svg.title: What to check before splitting comma-separated values in one Excel cell into multiple columns: empty columns and preserving the original
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check before splitting comma-separated values in
one Excel cell into multiple columns: empty columns and
preserving the original
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-01
Copy the original separately
Copy the column to be split to another sheet or
a blank workbook.
Check for empty columns to the right
Microsoft Support documentation states that the
split content overwrites the contents of cells
to the right.
Check the delimiter and preview
On the Data tab, run Text to Columns, choose
'Delimited,' and then select comma.
Check dates and leading zeros
After splitting, a value such as '2026-11-01'
may be converted to a date, or a number with
leading zeros, such as '00123,' may become…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
